subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector work land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue explicitly spans companion apps and session routing affects user-visible agent state, so automation should not choose the platform scope or permanent UX model.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk selection first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

options.title: Shared companion-app design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one Talk/Voice selector model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Defer after Chat selector
options.body: Wait until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80422 is repaired or closed, then reuse any accepted session-state model for Talk/Voice.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement Android Voice/Talk selection first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the TTS half as implemented and the Talk/Voice selector as remaining, and has recent history in the canonical TTS/session-adjacent path.
